notes: TCG: spells now come from packs. Everyone keeps the starter spells (Bolt of Zeus, Ambrosia, Gift of the Muses), and each of the first four cards in a pack has a 25% chance to be a spell. Rarer spells are rarer pulls. Spells you already put in a saved deck stay unlocked. Opening packs: Demigods and better, and every alternate art, now shine in their rarity's colour when you tap them, and you tap once more to reveal them.
